items.bm: OneID kini memaparkan penanda environment BM/English yang berterusan pada halaman login dan permukaan utama selepas login mengikut locale aktif.
items.en_draft: OneID now displays a persistent BM/English environment indicator on the login page and primary authenticated surfaces according to the active locale.

items.bm: Runtime local dan development memaparkan label DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT dengan identiti gradient teal yang khusus.
items.en_draft: Local and development runtimes display DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT with a dedicated teal gradient identity.

items.bm: Runtime staging memaparkan label STAGING ENVIRONMENT menggunakan gradient rasmi yang selaras dengan butang MyDigital ID.
items.en_draft: The staging runtime displays STAGING ENVIRONMENT using the official gradient aligned with the MyDigital ID button.

items.bm: Runtime production tidak menghasilkan sebarang markup banner supaya pengalaman pengguna production kekal bersih.
items.en_draft: The production runtime emits no banner markup, keeping the production user experience clean.

items.bm: Environment kosong atau tidak dikenali memaparkan amaran konfigurasi secara fail-visible dan tidak disalah anggap sebagai production.
items.en_draft: An empty or unknown environment is fail-visible as a configuration warning and is never mistaken for production.

items.bm: Banner dikongsi oleh login, cabaran MFA, dashboard pengguna, Account Security, Admin Step-Up, dashboard admin dan laporan pengguna.
items.en_draft: The shared banner covers login, MFA challenge, user dashboard, Account Security, Admin Step-Up, admin dashboard and user reports.

items.bm: Offset responsif memastikan banner tidak bertindih dengan navbar tetap pada paparan desktop atau mudah alih.
items.en_draft: Responsive offsets prevent the banner from overlapping fixed navigation on desktop or mobile displays.

items.bm: Gaya visual menggunakan highlight dalaman, border halus dan bayang berlapis tanpa animasi yang mengganggu.
items.en_draft: The visual treatment uses an inset highlight, subtle border and layered shadow without distracting animation.

items.bm: Contract release mengesahkan pemetaan local, staging, production, konfigurasi tidak sah serta liputan semua permukaan utama.
items.en_draft: Release contracts verify local, staging, production and invalid mappings together with coverage of every primary surface.

items.bm: Release ini tidak mengubah database, secret, token SSO, polisi MFA, MyDigital ID, Sync Apply atau integrasi service provider.
items.en_draft: This release does not alter the database, secrets, SSO tokens, MFA policy, MyDigital ID, Sync Apply or service-provider integrations.

items.bm: Ringkasan sinkronisasi kini menyemak gate Shadow Preview sebelum membina konfigurasi atau sambungan sumber ODL.
items.en_draft: The synchronization summary now checks the Shadow Preview gate before constructing ODL source configuration or connections.

items.bm: Apabila Shadow Preview dimatikan, endpoint memulangkan kod ODL_SHADOW_PREVIEW_DISABLED yang tepat dan bukan kegagalan generik.
items.en_draft: When Shadow Preview is disabled, the endpoint returns the precise ODL_SHADOW_PREVIEW_DISABLED code instead of a generic failure.

items.bm: Laluan fail-closed yang dimatikan tidak lagi memerlukan credential, host, port atau pangkalan data ODL tersedia.
items.en_draft: The disabled fail-closed path no longer requires ODL credentials, host, port or database configuration to be available.

items.bm: Perubahan mengekalkan Summary sebagai operasi baca sahaja tanpa membina approval atau laluan Apply.
items.en_draft: The change keeps Summary strictly read-only without constructing an approval or Apply path.

items.bm: Preview Staf, Prasiswazah dan ODL kekal diasingkan mengikut sumber serta tertakluk kepada baseline dan konfigurasi masing-masing.
items.en_draft: Staff, Undergraduate and ODL previews remain source-isolated and subject to their respective baselines and configuration.

items.bm: Semua respons kegagalan Summary terus menetapkan can_apply=false dan mutation_statements=0.
items.en_draft: Every Summary failure response continues to set can_apply=false and mutation_statements=0.

items.bm: Kontrak Shadow Preview mengesahkan susunan gate berlaku sebelum pembinaan dependency ODL luaran.
items.en_draft: The Shadow Preview contract verifies that the gate is evaluated before external ODL dependencies are constructed.

items.bm: Kontrak zero-mutation Sync Preview mengesahkan tiada panggilan persistence write diperkenalkan.
items.en_draft: The zero-mutation Sync Preview contract confirms that no persistence write call was introduced.

items.bm: Ujian browser staging mengesahkan Summary, Staf, Prasiswazah dan ODL Review berfungsi dengan konfigurasi read-only yang diluluskan.
items.en_draft: Staging browser tests confirm that Summary, Staff, Undergraduate and ODL Review work with the approved read-only configuration.

items.bm: Release ini tidak mengaktifkan Apply, Pilot, Full, Operational Apply, cron atau sebarang mutasi database production.
items.en_draft: This release does not activate Apply, Pilot, Full, Operational Apply, cron or any production database mutation.

items.bm: MyDigital ID kini memilih host callback berdaftar berdasarkan environment deployment OneID.
items.en_draft: MyDigital ID now selects the registered callback host from the OneID deployment environment.

items.bm: Environment staging hanya menerima callback oneid-uat.upnm.edu.my.
items.en_draft: The staging environment accepts only the oneid-uat.upnm.edu.my callback.

items.bm: Environment production hanya menerima callback oneid.upnm.edu.my.
items.en_draft: The production environment accepts only the oneid.upnm.edu.my callback.

items.bm: Callback silang antara staging dan production ditolak secara fail-closed.
items.en_draft: Cross-environment callbacks between staging and production are rejected fail-closed.

items.bm: Nilai environment yang kosong, tidak dikenali atau bukan string ditolak sebelum klien OIDC dibina.
items.en_draft: Empty, unknown or non-string environment values are rejected before the OIDC client is built.

items.bm: Callback kekal diwajibkan menggunakan HTTPS tanpa port, query, fragment atau maklumat pengguna.
items.en_draft: Callbacks continue to require HTTPS without ports, queries, fragments or user information.

items.bm: Path callback kekal dikunci kepada /auth/mydigitalid/callback.php.
items.en_draft: The callback path remains pinned to /auth/mydigitalid/callback.php.

items.bm: Post-logout redirect kekal dikunci kepada root domain environment yang sama.
items.en_draft: The post-logout redirect remains pinned to the root of the same environment domain.

items.bm: Ujian characterization meliputi konfigurasi staging, production dan penolakan silang kedua-dua arah.
items.en_draft: Characterization tests cover staging, production and cross-environment rejection in both directions.

items.bm: Perubahan tidak mengaktifkan MyDigital ID, mengubah secret, menjalankan migration atau memutasi database.
items.en_draft: The change does not activate MyDigital ID, alter secrets, run migrations or mutate the database.

items.bm: Sync Log Administrator kini merekod dan memaparkan sumber canonical bagi setiap sesi baharu sebagai Staf, Prasiswazah atau ODL.
items.en_draft: The Administrator Sync Log now records and displays the canonical source for each new session as Staff, Undergraduate or ODL.

items.bm: Setiap sumber yang diproses oleh cron menghasilkan sesi audit berasingan apabila terdapat perubahan, manakala sumber tanpa perubahan kekal tanpa header baharu.
items.en_draft: Each source processed by cron creates a separate audit session when changes exist, while sources with no changes continue without a new header.

items.bm: Rekod sejarah tanpa metadata sumber dipaparkan secara jujur sebagai Legacy / Tidak diketahui tanpa membuat inferens yang berisiko daripada data perubahan.
items.en_draft: Historical records without source metadata are honestly displayed as Legacy / Unknown without risky inference from change data.

items.bm: Sesi yang dimulakan oleh cron dan Administrator dibezakan dengan label Cron atau Manual serta identiti pelaksana yang jelas.
items.en_draft: Cron-triggered and Administrator-triggered sessions are distinguished with Cron or Manual labels and clear actor identity.

items.bm: Identiti Administrator manual kini memaparkan nama bersama nombor staf penuh daripada data3 dan tidak lagi mendedahkan nombor kad pengenalan sebagai paparan utama.
items.en_draft: Manual Administrator identity now shows the name with the full staff number from data3 and no longer exposes the identity card number as the primary display.

items.bm: Senarai Sync Log direka semula kepada susun atur enam kolum yang lebih padat dengan ID dan sumber digabungkan, masa mula dan tamat tersusun serta metrik perubahan yang kemas.
items.en_draft: The Sync Log list has been redesigned as a compact six-column layout with combined session and source, structured start and end times, and concise change metrics.

items.bm: Detail sesi memaparkan sasaran sebagai Nama dan nombor staf dengan fallback snapshot audit atau ID asal untuk rekod lama yang tidak lengkap.
items.en_draft: Session details display the target as name and staff number with an audit snapshot or original ID fallback for incomplete historical records.

items.bm: Pembacaan detail menyokong perbezaan collation antara jadual legacy melalui perbandingan ID binary tanpa migration atau perubahan kepada data pengguna.
items.en_draft: Detail reads support differing legacy table collations through binary ID comparison without a migration or user-data changes.

items.bm: Migration idempotent menambah source_code nullable dan indeks khusus pada header Sync Log, sementara Apply baharu gagal secara selamat jika schema belum tersedia.
items.en_draft: An idempotent migration adds a nullable source_code and dedicated index to Sync Log headers, while new Apply operations fail safely when the schema is unavailable.

items.bm: Perubahan ini kekal setempat kepada OneID Admin dan tidak mengubah token SSO, kontrak service provider, sumber data luaran atau aplikasi lain.
items.en_draft: These changes remain local to OneID Admin and do not alter SSO tokens, service-provider contracts, external data sources or other applications.

items.bm: PHP idle timeout portal pengguna kini mengikuti tetapan timeout Administrator semasa, dengan fallback selamat 30 minit dan had mutlak sesi lapan jam.
items.en_draft: The user portal PHP idle timeout now follows the current Administrator timeout setting, with a safe 30-minute fallback and an eight-hour absolute session boundary.

items.bm: Endpoint status, pembaharuan dan tamat sesi menggunakan deadline server yang berautoriti, CSRF serta kod respons stabil tanpa mengubah kontrak API aplikasi SSO lain.
items.en_draft: Session status, renewal and end endpoints use authoritative server deadlines, CSRF and stable response codes without changing other SSO application API contracts.

items.bm: Popup SweetAlert pengguna memberi amaran dua minit sebelum deadline efektif dan Stay Connected hanya memperbaharui sesi portal OneID tanpa rotate atau revoke token SSO.
items.en_draft: The user SweetAlert appears two minutes before the effective deadline, and Stay Connected renews only the OneID portal session without rotating or revoking the SSO token.

items.bm: Jika pengguna tidak memberi respons, sesi portal setempat tamat dengan selamat tanpa menutup sesi aplikasi lain yang masih menggunakan token SSO aktif.
items.en_draft: If the user does not respond, the local portal session ends safely without closing other applications that continue to use an active SSO token.

items.bm: Technical heartbeat dan status polling tidak memanjangkan idle session, manakala aktiviti pengguna yang bermakna menyelaraskan semula deadline dengan server.
items.en_draft: Technical heartbeat and status polling do not extend the idle session, while meaningful user activity resynchronizes the deadline with the server.

items.bm: Keadaan multi-tab, tab tersembunyi, back-forward cache, rangkaian terputus, ralat server, CSRF tidak sah, akaun tidak aktif dan token dibatalkan dikendalikan secara berasingan.
items.en_draft: Multi-tab, hidden-tab, back-forward cache, offline, server-error, invalid-CSRF, inactive-account and revoked-token states are handled independently.

items.bm: Sesi Administrator dan pengguna berkongsi deadline asas yang konsisten; pembaharuan grant Administrator tidak boleh menghidupkan semula sesi pengguna yang sudah tamat.
items.en_draft: Administrator and user sessions share a consistent base deadline; renewing the Administrator grant cannot revive a user session that has already expired.

items.bm: Audit khusus merekodkan sesi portal tamat, diperbaharui atau ditamatkan tanpa menambah perubahan kepada token validation dan integrasi service provider sedia ada.
items.en_draft: Dedicated audit events record portal session expiry, renewal and termination without changing existing token-validation and service-provider integrations.

items.bm: Readiness gate staging mengesahkan polisi timeout, endpoint, popup, heartbeat, sesi Administrator, SSO, multilingual dan kontrak keselamatan sebelum release.
items.en_draft: The staging readiness gate verifies timeout policy, endpoints, popup, heartbeat, Administrator sessions, SSO, multilingual and security contracts before release.

items.bm: Konfigurasi private runtime boleh disusun mengikut kategori dengan komen yang konsisten, backup automatik, pengesahan nilai dan pengekalan permission asal untuk akses PHP-FPM.
items.en_draft: Private runtime configuration can be organized into documented categories with automatic backup, value preservation checks and original permission retention for PHP-FPM access.

items.bm: Kategori Admin SSO kini mengira dan menyenaraikan akaun berdasarkan peranan Administrator aktif, bukan keahlian kategori biasa, supaya jumlah sebenar dipaparkan dengan tepat.
items.en_draft: The Admin SSO category now counts and lists accounts by active Administrator role rather than ordinary category membership, so the true total is displayed accurately.

items.bm: Data ujian bukan Administrator dikeluarkan daripada peranan Admin SSO manakala tiga Administrator sah dikekalkan tanpa mengubah status staf biasa mereka.
items.en_draft: The non-Administrator test record was removed from the Admin SSO role while the three legitimate Administrators remain unchanged as ordinary staff accounts.

items.bm: Laporan User List kategori direka semula sebagai paparan print-ready profesional dengan identiti UPNM dan OneID, metadata kategori, masa penjanaan, rujukan laporan serta jumlah pengguna.
items.en_draft: The category User List report has been redesigned as a professional print-ready view with UPNM and OneID identity, category metadata, generation time, report reference and total users.

items.bm: Kolum pengenalan laporan kini memaparkan nombor staf daripada data3 bagi staf dan nombor matrik daripada data4 bagi pelajar tanpa mendedahkan nombor kad pengenalan.
items.en_draft: The report identifier column now displays staff numbers from data3 for staff and matric numbers from data4 for students without exposing identity card numbers.

items.bm: Nama tambahan daripada data7 dipaparkan pada baris kecil di bawah nama utama, manakala lebar kolum ID, Nama dan Description diseimbangkan untuk cetakan A4 landskap.
items.en_draft: The additional name from data7 appears as a smaller line beneath the primary name, while the ID, Name and Description columns are balanced for A4 landscape printing.

items.bm: Laporan cetak menyokong header berulang, baris yang tidak terpotong, warna cetakan konsisten, paparan responsif dan tindakan kembali atau cetak yang diasingkan daripada output fizikal.
items.en_draft: The print report supports repeating headers, unbroken rows, consistent print colours, responsive display and return or print actions that are excluded from physical output.

items.bm: Sesi Administrator kini memaparkan amaran SweetAlert dengan countdown tepat dua minit sebelum grant ADMIN_ACCESS tamat bagi semua nilai lifetime konfigurasi.
items.en_draft: Administrator sessions now show a SweetAlert warning with an exact countdown two minutes before the ADMIN_ACCESS grant expires for every configured lifetime.

items.bm: Popup sesi menggunakan layout profesional responsif dengan identiti OneID, lapisan latar kabur, hierarki keselamatan, badge countdown serta tindakan Kekal Bersambung atau kembali ke akaun pengguna.
items.en_draft: The session popup uses a professional responsive layout with OneID identity, a blurred backdrop, security hierarchy, countdown badge and actions to stay connected or return to the user account.

items.bm: Kekal Bersambung menggantikan grant lama secara atomik menggunakan lifetime konfigurasi semasa, CSRF, binding sesi dan pelayar, transaksi database serta audit event ADMIN_ACCESS_RENEW.
items.en_draft: Stay Connected atomically replaces the old grant using the current configured lifetime, CSRF, session and browser binding, a database transaction and the ADMIN_ACCESS_RENEW audit event.

items.bm: Pembaharuan grant diselaraskan merentas tab dan semakan status server diklasifikasikan sebagai technical heartbeat supaya polling tidak memanjangkan idle session pengguna.
items.en_draft: Grant renewal is synchronized across tabs, and server status checks are classified as technical heartbeats so polling does not extend the user idle session.

items.bm: Jika tiada respons, grant tamat secara server-side dan Administrator dikembalikan ke dashboard pengguna tanpa menamatkan token SSO yang masih aktif; akses admin seterusnya memerlukan pengesahan semula.
items.en_draft: Without a response, the grant expires server-side and the Administrator returns to the user dashboard without ending an otherwise active SSO token; entering admin again requires fresh verification.

items.bm: Selepas pembaharuan berjaya, mesej pengesahan kekal terbuka sehingga Administrator menekan OK dan tidak lagi ditutup secara automatik.
items.en_draft: After a successful renewal, the confirmation remains open until the Administrator presses OK and no longer closes automatically.

items.bm: Asset JavaScript dan CSS sesi Administrator kini dilayan daripada public web root dengan cache versioning, contract runtime dan regression checks bagi mencegah kegagalan popup berulang.
items.en_draft: Administrator session JavaScript and CSS assets are now served from the public web root with cache versioning, runtime contracts and regression checks to prevent recurring popup failures.

items.bm: External Sync staging kini dijalankan tepat pada awal setiap jam untuk sumber Staff, Prasiswazah dan ODL.
items.en_draft: Staging External Sync now runs exactly at the start of every hour for Staff, Undergraduate and ODL sources.

items.bm: Setiap sumber dibandingkan secara berasingan dan tamat sebagai SKIP_NO_CHANGES tanpa transaction atau perubahan database apabila tiada tindakan diperlukan.
items.en_draft: Each source is compared separately and exits as SKIP_NO_CHANGES without a transaction or database mutation when no action is required.

items.bm: Staging boleh memproses semua perubahan selamat termasuk New, Update, Deactivate dan Reactivate tanpa had volum cron.
items.en_draft: Staging can process every safe change, including New, Update, Deactivate and Reactivate, without cron volume limits.

items.bm: Kawalan integriti bagi sumber gagal atau kosong, identity collision, plan drift dan reconciliation mismatch kekal fail-closed.
items.en_draft: Integrity controls for failed or empty sources, identity collisions, plan drift and reconciliation mismatches remain fail-closed.

items.bm: Filesystem flock dan database advisory lock menghalang cron, sync manual atau run sebelumnya daripada menulis secara bertindih.
items.en_draft: Filesystem flock and the database advisory lock prevent cron, manual sync or an earlier run from writing concurrently.

items.bm: Kegagalan database cron kini melaporkan stage, SQLSTATE dan driver code yang selamat tanpa mendedahkan SQL, credential atau data pengguna.
items.en_draft: Cron database failures now report a safe stage, SQLSTATE and driver code without exposing SQL, credentials or user data.

items.bm: Identiti service cron dipendekkan kepada ONEID-CRON supaya serasi dengan medan triggered_by legacy dan kekal jelas dalam audit.
items.en_draft: The cron service identity is shortened to ONEID-CRON for compatibility with the legacy triggered_by field and clear audit attribution.

items.bm: Log External Sync dirotasi setiap minggu, dimampatkan dan disimpan sehingga 52 minggu untuk sejarah operasi setahun.
items.en_draft: External Sync logs are rotated weekly, compressed and retained for up to 52 weeks to provide one year of operational history.

items.bm: Runtime staging mengekalkan permission 640 serta ownership iqs:www-data supaya CLI cron dan PHP-FPM boleh membaca konfigurasi private yang sama.
items.en_draft: The staging runtime retains mode 640 and iqs:www-data ownership so CLI cron and PHP-FPM can read the same private configuration.

items.bm: Contract cron, transaction, rollback, reconciliation, metadata release dan validasi operasi staging telah disahkan lulus.
items.en_draft: Cron, transaction, rollback, reconciliation, release metadata and staging operational validation contracts were verified successfully.

items.bm: Active Sessions Administrator direka semula kepada jadual empat kolum yang lebih padat dengan carian, filter lifecycle, metrik status dan pagination 10 rekod secara default.
items.en_draft: Administrator Active Sessions has been redesigned as a compact four-column table with search, lifecycle filters, status metrics and 10-row pagination by default.

items.bm: Administrator boleh membatalkan sesi Due atau Expired melalui aliran Preview dan Apply yang memerlukan Step-Up, sebab pentadbiran serta exact confirmation.
items.en_draft: Administrators can revoke Due or Expired sessions through a Preview and Apply flow that requires Step-Up, an administrative reason and exact confirmation.

items.bm: Pembatalan sesi menggunakan opaque one-use target, transaction tepat, perlindungan self-lockout dan audit correlation supaya sesi tidak boleh ditamatkan sewenang-wenangnya.
items.en_draft: Session revocation uses an opaque one-use target, an exact transaction, self-lockout protection and correlation auditing so sessions cannot be ended arbitrarily.

items.bm: Centralized return-context memulihkan tab dan subtab Administrator yang tepat selepas Step-Up sebelum transaksi Preview atau Apply disambung semula.
items.en_draft: Centralized return context restores the exact Administrator tab and subtab after Step-Up before the Preview or Apply transaction resumes.

items.bm: Audit Log kini memuat rekod tarikh hari ini secara automatik apabila tab dibuka tanpa menunggu Administrator menekan Search.
items.en_draft: Audit Log now loads records for today automatically when its tab opens without waiting for the Administrator to press Search.

items.bm: Kad profil Administrator menggunakan cover OneID, badge peranan, foto bulat, nama, nombor staf, jabatan, jawatan dan pemilih bahasa dalam susun atur profesional.
items.en_draft: The Administrator profile card now uses a OneID cover, role badge, circular photo, name, staff number, department, position and language selector in a professional layout.

items.bm: Foto profil Administrator dan pengguna Active Sessions dimuat melalui resolver OneID same-origin yang berkongsi sumber Staff dan Pelajar serta fallback tempatan.
items.en_draft: Administrator and Active Sessions profile photos are loaded through a same-origin OneID resolver that shares Staff and Student sources with a local fallback.

items.bm: Resolver foto pengguna lain hanya tersedia kepada Administrator dengan sesi SSO aktif, ID tervalidasi, HTTPS, semakan TLS, timeout, had saiz dan pengesahan MIME.
items.en_draft: Resolving another user photo is limited to Administrators with an active SSO session, validated IDs, HTTPS, TLS checks, timeouts, size limits and MIME validation.

items.bm: Dashboard pengguna kini memaparkan badge peranan PENGGUNA atau USER mengikut bahasa dengan gaya visual yang selaras dengan kad Administrator.
items.en_draft: The user dashboard now displays a localized PENGGUNA or USER role badge with a visual style aligned to the Administrator card.

items.bm: Contract multilingual, profile photo, Active Sessions, controlled revocation dan return-context telah disahkan lulus sebelum deployment staging.
items.en_draft: Multilingual, profile photo, Active Sessions, controlled revocation and return-context contracts were verified before staging deployment.

items.bm: External Sync kini menyediakan cronjob conditional untuk memeriksa dan menyelaraskan sumber Staff, Prasiswazah dan ODL secara automatik mengikut jadual operasi.
items.en_draft: External Sync now provides a conditional cron job to check and synchronize Staff, Undergraduate and ODL sources automatically according to the operational schedule.

items.bm: Cron memisahkan setiap source kepada plan dan keputusan tersendiri supaya data Staff, Prasiswazah dan ODL tidak bercampur semasa synchronization.
items.en_draft: Cron separates every source into its own plan and outcome so Staff, Undergraduate and ODL data cannot be mixed during synchronization.

items.bm: Apabila tiada perubahan, cron tamat sebagai SKIP_NO_CHANGES tanpa transaction, header Sync Log atau perubahan database.
items.en_draft: When there are no changes, cron exits with SKIP_NO_CHANGES without a transaction, Sync Log header or database mutation.

items.bm: New, Update dan Reactivate hanya diproses apabila jumlah berada dalam threshold khusus source dan semua safety gate lulus.
items.en_draft: New, Update and Reactivate actions are processed only when their counts are within source-specific thresholds and every safety gate passes.

items.bm: Sebarang Deactivate, collision, anomaly, warning atau perubahan melebihi threshold disekat dan diserahkan kepada Administrator untuk semakan manual.
items.en_draft: Any Deactivate, collision, anomaly, warning or over-threshold change is blocked and handed to an Administrator for manual review.

items.bm: Cron menggunakan one-use exact-plan approval, fresh snapshot verification, advisory lock, transaction, reconciliation dan audit marker yang sama ketat dengan safe writer.
items.en_draft: Cron uses one-use exact-plan approval, fresh snapshot verification, advisory locking, transactions, reconciliation and an audit marker with the same strict safe writer.

items.bm: Dry-run dan emergency-disable flag membolehkan scheduler diperiksa atau dihentikan tanpa menutup fungsi Preview dan Apply manual Administrator.
items.en_draft: Dry-run and emergency-disable flags allow the scheduler to be assessed or stopped without disabling Administrator manual Preview and Apply.

items.bm: Staff provenance, UG membership dan ODL source isolation melindungi ownership akaun serta mencegah perubahan merentas sumber.
items.en_draft: Staff provenance, UG membership and ODL source isolation protect account ownership and prevent cross-source mutation.

items.bm: CLI runner menolak akses HTTP, tidak menggunakan session Administrator dan menghasilkan output beraudit tanpa IC, matrik, nama atau e-mel.
items.en_draft: The CLI runner rejects HTTP access, does not use an Administrator session and produces audited output without identity numbers, student IDs, names or e-mail addresses.

items.bm: Contract cron, sync safety, source-scoped Apply dan ODL operational regression telah disahkan lulus sebelum deployment staging.
items.en_draft: Cron, sync safety, source-scoped Apply and ODL operational regression contracts were verified before staging deployment.

items.bm: Administrator kini boleh mengurus banner halaman login secara terus melalui Configuration tanpa mengubah source code bagi setiap pertukaran kandungan.
items.en_draft: Administrators can now manage login-page banners directly through Configuration without changing source code for every content update.

items.bm: Banner menyokong imej BM dan English yang berasingan atau satu imej bersama, lengkap dengan teks alternatif mengikut bahasa.
items.en_draft: Banners support separate BM and English images or one shared image, with language-specific alternative text.

items.bm: Administrator boleh mencipta draf, mengemas kini imej atau jadual, menerbitkan, menyahaktifkan, menyusun semula dan rollback banner terdahulu.
items.en_draft: Administrators can create drafts, update images or schedules, publish, inactivate, reorder and roll back earlier banners.

items.bm: Muat naik JPEG, PNG dan WebP divalidasi serta dinormalisasikan kepada aset WebP immutable dengan kawalan dimensi, saiz dan integriti.
items.en_draft: JPEG, PNG and WebP uploads are validated and normalized into immutable WebP assets with dimension, size and integrity controls.

items.bm: Halaman login memilih banner mengikut bahasa pengguna dan kembali kepada banner statik dengan selamat jika aset dinamik tidak tersedia.
items.en_draft: The login page selects banners according to the user language and safely returns to static banners when dynamic assets are unavailable.

items.bm: Operasi banner mempunyai versioning, audit, backup, reconciliation dan rollback untuk menyokong pemulihan serta pengesanan perubahan.
items.en_draft: Banner operations include versioning, audit, backup, reconciliation and rollback to support recovery and change traceability.

items.bm: Dialog pengurusan banner menggunakan SweetAlert, dan imej yang sama boleh digunakan semula tanpa menghasilkan ralat aset pendua.
items.en_draft: Banner management dialogs now use SweetAlert, and an identical image can be reused without causing a duplicate-asset error.

items.bm: Configuration kini disusun kepada General, Security, Multi-Factor Authentication dan Audit dengan subtab serta kandungan yang terasing dengan betul.
items.en_draft: Configuration is now organized into General, Security, Multi-Factor Authentication and Audit with correctly isolated subtabs and content.

items.bm: Garisan header mempunyai pergerakan cahaya kiri-kanan yang lebih lembut, nipis dan berbilang warna selaras dengan identiti OneID.
items.en_draft: The header line now has a softer, thinner, multicolour left-to-right motion aligned with the OneID visual identity.

items.bm: Halaman cabaran User 2FA kini menggunakan penerangan keselamatan akaun pengguna yang berasingan daripada mesej Admin Step-Up.
items.en_draft: The User 2FA challenge now uses user-account security guidance that is separate from the Admin Step-Up message.

items.bm: ODL di staging kini menyokong Preview dan Apply secara on-demand tanpa perlu mengubah operational window bagi setiap ujian.
items.en_draft: ODL staging now supports on-demand Preview and Apply without changing the operational window for every test.

items.bm: Had volum Sync kini menjadi amaran dan pengesahan tambahan; perubahan sah dalam jumlah besar boleh diteruskan sementara ralat integriti kekal disekat.
items.en_draft: Sync volume limits are now warnings with additional confirmation; legitimate large changes can proceed while integrity errors remain blocked.

items.bm: Kiraan External Sync, badge dan ringkasan kini disegarkan selepas child modal ditutup supaya keputusan terkini dipaparkan tanpa refresh halaman.
items.en_draft: External Sync counts, badges and summaries now refresh when a child modal closes so the latest result appears without a page refresh.

items.bm: Paparan Protected Manual Accounts dikeluarkan daripada UI Sync, tetapi perlindungan backend terhadap akaun manual kekal aktif.
items.en_draft: Protected Manual Accounts has been removed from the Sync UI while backend protection for manual accounts remains active.

items.bm: Pengguna baharu yang masuk melalui MyDigital ID kini boleh menetapkan kata laluan OneID tanpa memasukkan kata laluan lama yang tidak pernah diketahui.
items.en_draft: New users signing in through MyDigital ID can now set a OneID password without entering an old password they never knew.

items.bm: Initial password setup MyDigital ID menggunakan grant lima minit yang terikat kepada pengguna dan sesi, kemudian membatalkan token lama serta meminta login semula.
items.en_draft: MyDigital ID initial password setup uses a five-minute user- and session-bound grant, then revokes old tokens and requires sign-in again.

items.bm: Halaman padanan MyDigital ID yang gagal kini memberi arahan generik yang lebih membantu untuk login menggunakan ID OneID tanpa mendedahkan status akaun.
items.en_draft: The unmatched MyDigital ID page now gives more helpful generic guidance for signing in with a OneID ID without exposing account status.

items.bm: Menu Account Security dan halaman enrollment kini memuatkan dependency User MFA secara terus supaya tersedia secara konsisten pada staging.
items.en_draft: The Account Security menu and enrollment page now load User MFA dependencies directly for consistent staging availability.

items.bm: Header dashboard pengguna dan admin mempunyai pergerakan cahaya halus pada garisan bawah dengan sokongan Reduce Motion.
items.en_draft: User and administrator dashboard headers now include a subtle moving light along the lower line with Reduce Motion support.

items.bm: Paparan Account Security diperkemas, lebih padat dan menyokong enrollment serta pemulihan Microsoft Authenticator dengan lebih jelas.
items.en_draft: Account Security has been refined into a more compact view with clearer Microsoft Authenticator enrollment and recovery.

items.bm: User 2FA kini tersedia sepenuhnya untuk akaun staf dan pelajar aktif melalui e-mel OTP atau Microsoft Authenticator.
items.en_draft: User 2FA is now fully available to active staff and student accounts through e-mail OTP or Microsoft Authenticator.

items.bm: Polisi global User 2FA menyediakan mod Off, Enrollment, Pilot Enforced dan Enforced dengan runtime/database parity yang fail-closed.
items.en_draft: The global User 2FA policy provides Off, Enrollment, Pilot Enforced and Enforced modes with fail-closed runtime/database parity.

items.bm: Pentadbir boleh mengaktifkan enforcement secara berasingan untuk kategori Staff dan Student tanpa menjejaskan Admin 2FA.
items.en_draft: Administrators can enable enforcement separately for Staff and Student categories without affecting Admin 2FA.

items.bm: Akaun pentadbir dikecualikan daripada User 2FA dan terus menggunakan Admin Step-Up 2FA yang berasingan.
items.en_draft: Administrator accounts are excluded from User 2FA and continue to use the separate Admin Step-Up 2FA flow.

items.bm: Temporary User 2FA Exemption membolehkan seorang pengguna aktif dikecualikan untuk tempoh terhad dengan sebab, rujukan dan compensating control.
items.en_draft: Temporary User 2FA Exemption allows one active user to be excluded for a limited period with a reason, reference and compensating control.

items.bm: Carian exemption menyokong ID, nama dan identity reference secara masa nyata dengan keputusan terhad dan boleh ditatal.
items.en_draft: Exemption search supports real-time ID, name and identity-reference lookup with limited scrollable results.

items.bm: Pengguna boleh enroll, memilih dan revoke Microsoft Authenticator melalui Account Security, termasuk pemulihan revoke menggunakan OTP e-mel.
items.en_draft: Users can enroll, select and revoke Microsoft Authenticator through Account Security, including e-mail OTP recovery for revocation.

items.bm: Enrollment, OTP, TOTP, session rotation, rate limit, audit dan recovery dilindungi oleh kawalan backend serta UI BM/English.
items.en_draft: Enrollment, OTP, TOTP, session rotation, rate limits, audit and recovery are protected by backend controls and BM/English UI.

items.bm: Full enforcement memerlukan dua pentadbir aktif yang berbeza, exact confirmation, versioned policy history dan correlated audit.
items.en_draft: Full enforcement requires two distinct active administrators, exact confirmation, versioned policy history and correlated audit.

items.bm: User 2FA full enforcement telah diaktifkan di staging bagi Staff dan Student dengan e-mel serta TOTP enabled.
items.en_draft: User 2FA full enforcement has been activated in staging for Staff and Student with e-mail and TOTP enabled.

items.bm: Log masuk menggunakan MyDigital ID kini tersedia sebagai pilihan kedua di samping log masuk OneID biasa.
items.en_draft: Sign in with MyDigital ID is now available as a second option alongside the standard OneID login.

items.bm: Hanya pengguna yang mempunyai akaun OneID aktif dibenarkan masuk; pengguna lain menerima mesej penolakan yang jelas tanpa akaun baharu dicipta.
items.en_draft: Only users with an active OneID account may sign in; other users receive a clear rejection message and no new account is created.

items.bm: Pengguna boleh mencuba akaun MyDigital ID yang lain, dan proses log keluar kini turut menamatkan sesi MyDigital ID.
items.en_draft: Users can try a different MyDigital ID account, and signing out now also ends the MyDigital ID session.

items.bm: Paparan log masuk, mesej BM/English, rekod aktiviti dan perlindungan maklumat log masuk telah dipertingkatkan.
items.en_draft: The login screen, BM/English messages, activity records and protection of sign-in information have been improved.

items.bm: Pengguna yang tidak mempunyai akses OneID kini dibawa ke halaman khas dengan mesej yang jelas serta pilihan untuk mencuba akaun MyDigital ID lain.
items.en_draft: Users without OneID access are now taken to a dedicated page with a clear message and an option to try another MyDigital ID account.

items.bm: Alamat OneID yang tidak sah kini memaparkan halaman 404 khas yang lebih jelas dan mesra pengguna.
items.en_draft: Invalid OneID addresses now display a clearer, user-friendly custom 404 page.

items.bm: Infrastruktur locale BM/English dilengkapkan dengan Bahasa Melayu sebagai default dan hard fallback, English sebagai bahasa kedua serta preference pengguna, sesi dan cookie yang divalidasi.
items.en_draft: The BM/English locale infrastructure is complete with Bahasa Melayu as the default and hard fallback, English as the secondary language, and validated user, session and cookie preferences.

items.bm: Login, Pemulihan Kata Laluan, OTP, User Dashboard dan Administrator Dashboard kini menyokong pertukaran BM/English tanpa mengubah authentication, authorization atau ACL.
items.en_draft: Login, Password Recovery, OTP, the User Dashboard and the Administrator Dashboard now support BM/English switching without changing authentication, authorization or ACL behaviour.

items.bm: Active Sessions, Audit Log, Sync Audit, Configuration dan senarai pengguna kategori dilengkapkan dengan label, pagination serta loading, empty, success dan error state BM/English.
items.en_draft: Active Sessions, Audit Log, Sync Audit, Configuration and category user lists now provide BM/English labels, pagination, and loading, empty, success and error states.

items.bm: External Sync Summary, Staff, Prasiswazah dan ODL kini mempunyai presentation BM/English sementara source code, plan hash, counts, correlation ID dan exact confirmation kekal canonical.
items.en_draft: External Sync Summary, Staff, Undergraduate and ODL now provide BM/English presentation while source codes, plan hashes, counts, correlation IDs and exact confirmations remain canonical.

items.bm: Admin Step-Up menyokong arahan dan feedback BM/English bagi OTP e-mel, Microsoft Authenticator, enrollment, reset, expiry dan rate limit tanpa mengubah purpose, factor atau grant security.
items.en_draft: Admin Step-Up provides BM/English guidance and feedback for e-mail OTP, Microsoft Authenticator, enrollment, reset, expiry and rate limits without changing purpose, factor or grant security.

items.bm: API/AJAX, notification dan e-mel dalam skop dilengkapi stable response code serta translation key sambil mengekalkan legacy msg untuk compatibility.
items.en_draft: In-scope API/AJAX responses, notifications and e-mails now use stable response codes and translation keys while retaining legacy msg compatibility.

items.bm: Metadata aplikasi dan kategori menggunakan translation tables additive, fallback kepada metadata asal, audit history dan optimistic concurrency tanpa mengubah ID, URL, SSO atau ACL.
items.en_draft: Application and category metadata use additive translation tables, original-metadata fallback, audit history and optimistic concurrency without changing IDs, URLs, SSO or ACL configuration.

items.bm: Semua 84 rekod metadata diklasifikasi; 33 terjemahan English baharu dan 33 audit history telah direkonsiliasi dengan content completeness 100%.
items.en_draft: All 84 metadata records were classified; 33 new English translations and 33 audit-history records were reconciled with 100% content completeness.

items.bm: Login dan User Dashboard berkongsi 8 FAQ BM/English daripada satu sumber kandungan dengan explicit fallback notice dan accessibility semantics.
items.en_draft: Login and the User Dashboard share 8 BM/English FAQs from one content source with an explicit fallback notice and accessible semantics.

items.bm: Administrator Version Releases mempunyai parity 37/37 release dan 217/217 changelog BM/English dengan digest approval fail-closed serta fallback penuh kepada BM.
items.en_draft: Administrator Version Releases provide parity for 37/37 releases and 217/217 BM/English changelog items with fail-closed approval binding and full BM fallback.

items.bm: English User Manual PDF ditangguhkan oleh owner; MANUAL_SALAM.pdf kekal rasmi dan pengguna English menerima notis fallback BM yang jelas.
items.en_draft: The English User Manual PDF is deferred by the owner; MANUAL_SALAM.pdf remains official and English users receive a clear BM fallback notice.

items.bm: Audit pre-ML9 merekonsiliasi semua fasa multilingual sebagai PASS/CLOSED pada Local WSL dengan document inventory 149, duplicate 0, missing target 0 dan blocking code 0.
items.en_draft: The pre-ML9 audit reconciled every multilingual phase as PASS/CLOSED on Local WSL with 149 document identities, 0 duplicates, 0 missing targets and 0 blocking codes.

items.bm: ODL Fasa 9 Manual Operational Sync ditutup selepas exact-plan Apply menambah 18 akaun NEW melalui header 50; active membership STUDENT_ODL_PG meningkat kepada 71.
items.en_draft: ODL Phase 9 Manual Operational Sync closed after exact-plan Apply added 18 NEW accounts via header 50; active membership STUDENT_ODL_PG increased to 71.

items.bm: F9A melengkapkan semua tindakan manual ODL: UPDATE dan DEACTIVATE melalui header 52 serta REACTIVATE melalui header 53 dengan reconciliation dan rollback readiness PASS.
items.en_draft: F9A completes all ODL manual actions: UPDATE and DEACTIVATE through header 52 and REACTIVATE through header 53 with reconciliation and rollback readiness PASS.

items.bm: Post-Apply Preview kembali zero action; akaun ujian kekal kategori Pelajar/10, membership ODL aktif serta login dan ACL smoke test PASS.
items.en_draft: Post-Apply Preview returns zero action; permanent test account for Student/10 category, active ODL membership and login and ACL smoke test PASS.

items.bm: Badge sumber kini hanya memaparkan tindakan sebenar dan tidak lagi mengira rekod KEEP yang telah diselaraskan.
items.en_draft: Resource badges now only display actual actions and no longer count adjusted KEEP records.

items.bm: Menu Add User dinamakan semula kepada Sync User dan setiap sumber Staff, Prasiswazah serta ODL mengekalkan Preview/Apply yang terasing.
items.en_draft: The Add User menu is renamed to Sync User and each Staff, Undergraduate and ODL resource maintains a separate Preview/Apply.

items.bm: Paparan External Sync menggunakan istilah mesra admin, keputusan berorientasikan tindakan dan bahagian teknikal tertutup untuk rujukan audit.
items.en_draft: External Sync View uses admin-friendly terminology, action-oriented results and closed technical sections for audit reference.

items.bm: Ringkasan Sync memaparkan jumlah rekod, tindakan dan status berasingan bagi Staff, Prasiswazah dan ODL tanpa fungsi Apply.
items.en_draft: Sync Summary displays separate record totals, actions and statuses for Staff, Undergraduate and ODL without the Apply function.

items.bm: Parent modal Sync User serta semua child modal Summary, Preview/Apply dan Manual Add User direka semula dengan warna konsisten, layout responsif dan hierarchy visual profesional.
items.en_draft: Parent modal Sync User as well as all child modal Summary, Preview/Apply and Manual Add User redesigned with consistent colors, responsive layout and professional visual hierarchy.

items.bm: Label akaun manual dilindungi dan konflik identiti kini diasingkan supaya status keselamatan lebih mudah difahami.
items.en_draft: Manual account labels are protected and identity conflicts are now separated so security status is easier to understand.

items.bm: Exact confirmation, source isolation, transaction safety dan audit gate tidak diubah oleh penambahbaikan UI.
items.en_draft: Exact confirmation, source isolation, transaction safety and audit gate are not changed by UI improvements.

items.bm: Automatic scheduler, unattended mutation dan production rollout ODL kekal disabled.
items.en_draft: Automatic scheduler, unattended mutation and ODL production rollout remain disabled.

items.bm: ODL Fasa 7 Controlled Pilot selesai dengan tiga akaun NEW, provenance STUDENT_ODL_PG, reconciliation tepat serta login dan ACL smoke test PASS.
items.en_draft: ODL Phase 7 Controlled Pilot completed with three NEW accounts, provenance STUDENT_ODL_PG, accurate reconciliation and login and ACL smoke test PASS.

items.bm: ODL Fasa 8 Controlled Full Apply selesai untuk 50 akaun NEW; keseluruhan 53 membership ODL aktif dan semua tindakan bukan NEW kekal sifar.
items.en_draft: ODL Phase 8 Controlled Full Apply completed for 50 NEW accounts; a total of 53 active ODL memberships and all non-NEW actions remain zero.

items.bm: Cross-source isolation kini meliputi Staff, Undergraduate, ODL dan akaun manual supaya Preview serta Apply tidak mencampurkan ownership sumber.
items.en_draft: Cross-source isolation now covers Staff, Undergraduate, ODL and manual accounts so that Preview and Apply do not mix resource ownership.

items.bm: Fasa 9 menyediakan ODL Manual Operational Preview melalui modal Admin yang sama seperti Undergraduate dengan plan hash, expiry dan action counts.
items.en_draft: Phase 9 provides ODL Manual Operational Preview through the same Admin capital as Undergraduate with plan hash, expiry and action counts.

items.bm: ODL operational Apply mempunyai private gate berasingan dan kekal disabled sehingga exact-plan authorization diterima.
items.en_draft: ODL operational Apply has a separate private gate and remains disabled until exact-plan authorization is received.

items.bm: Matrik, IC dan external membership collision diblock sebelum approval; persistence turut menyemak semula ownership dalam transaction.
items.en_draft: Matrik, IC and external membership collision blocked before approval; persistence also checks the ownership in the transaction.

items.bm: E-mel kosong daripada ODL tidak memadam e-mel OneID sedia ada, manakala akaun manual kekal protected.
items.en_draft: Empty emails from ODL do not delete existing OneID emails, while manual accounts remain protected.

items.bm: External Sync Summary kekal read-only dan notifikasi parent modal dipaparkan hanya apabila sesuatu sumber mempunyai tindakan atau block.
items.en_draft: External Sync Summary remains read-only and the modal parent notification is displayed only when a resource has an action or block.

items.bm: Automatic scheduler, unattended mutation dan production rollout ODL kekal disabled.
items.en_draft: Automatic scheduler, unattended mutation and ODL production rollout remain disabled.

items.bm: Dokumen audit merekod Fasa 0 hingga 8 PASS/CLOSED serta Fasa 9 Preview Ready di bawah ONEID-ODL-F9-20260724-01.
items.en_draft: The audit document records Phases 0 to 8 PASS/CLOSED and Phase 9 Preview Ready under ONEID-ODL-F9-20260724-01.

items.bm: External Sync dipisahkan kepada Summary, Staff, Undergraduate dan ODL supaya status serta tindakan setiap sumber tidak bercampur.
items.en_draft: External Sync is separated into Summary, Staff, Undergraduate and ODL so that the status and actions of each resource are not mixed.

items.bm: Staff dan Undergraduate menggunakan Preview serta Operational Apply berasingan yang diikat kepada source, one-time approval dan fresh writer plan.
items.en_draft: Staff and Undergraduate use separate Preview and Operational Apply which are tied to source, one-time approval and fresh writer plan.

items.bm: ODL postgraduate diperkenalkan melalui provenance schema, adapter MySQL read-only, TLS fail-closed, data-quality audit dan Shadow Preview.
items.en_draft: ODL postgraduate is introduced through provenance schema, MySQL read-only adapter, TLS file-closed, data-quality audit and Shadow Preview.

items.bm: Parent modal menerima notifikasi source-specific, Preview modal diperluas dan child modal kembali kepada pilihan utama apabila ditutup.
items.en_draft: Parent modal receives source-specific notifications, Preview modal is expanded and child modal returns to main selection when closed.

items.bm: ODL Apply dan automatic scheduler kekal disabled pada baseline release ini.
items.en_draft: ODL Apply and automatic scheduler remain disabled on this baseline release.

items.bm: Admin Step-Up 2FA kini melindungi akses Administrator dan perubahan konfigurasi sensitif menggunakan OTP e-mel atau Microsoft Authenticator.
items.en_draft: Admin Step-Up 2FA now protects Administrator access and sensitive configuration changes using email OTP or Microsoft Authenticator.

items.bm: Lifecycle TOTP lengkap merangkumi enrollment QR lokal, secret terenkripsi, confirmation, anti-replay, preference per-admin serta reset dan revoke beraudit.
items.en_draft: Complete TOTP lifecycle includes local QR enrollment, encrypted secret, confirmation, anti-replay, per-admin preference as well as audited reset and revoke.

items.bm: Grant keselamatan diikat kepada admin, session, browser dan purpose; session serta CSRF dirotasi selepas verification berjaya.
items.en_draft: Security grants are tied to admin, session, browser and purpose; session and CSRF are rotated after successful verification.

items.bm: Controlled bootstrap, lifetime grant, audit berstruktur, recovery OTP e-mel, monitoring F7.6 dan rollback fail-closed telah dilaksanakan dan diuji di staging.
items.en_draft: Controlled bootstrap, lifetime grant, structured audit, email OTP recovery, F7.6 monitoring and fail-closed rollback have been implemented and tested in staging.

items.bm: Issuer Authenticator boleh dibezakan mengikut environment, manakala keyring kekal di luar Git dan mesti boleh dibaca oleh akaun PHP-FPM.
items.en_draft: The Issuer Authenticator can be differentiated by environment, while the keyring remains outside of Git and must be readable by the PHP-FPM account.

items.bm: Reset Authenticator menggunakan SweetAlert dan enrollment kini memberikan diagnosis keyring yang selamat tanpa mendedahkan path, secret atau OTP.
items.en_draft: Reset Authenticator using SweetAlert and enrollment now provides secure keyring diagnosis without revealing path, secret or OTP.

items.bm: Gambar profil dashboard pengguna kini melalui resolver same-origin supaya Firefox tidak lagi membuat probe terus ke domain gambar luar.
items.en_draft: User dashboard profile images now go through the same-origin resolver so that Firefox no longer probes directly to external image domains.

items.bm: Akaun tanpa ID gambar, ID tidak sah atau akaun TEST terus menerima fallback profile lokal tanpa request upstream.
items.en_draft: Accounts without picture ID, invalid ID or TEST account continue to receive local profile fallback without upstream request.

items.bm: Resolver menguatkuasakan active session, HTTPS/TLS verification, timeout, had 2MB dan decoded MIME validation sebelum gambar dipaparkan.
items.en_draft: Resolver enforces active session, HTTPS/TLS verification, timeout, 2MB limit and decoded MIME validation before the image is displayed.

items.bm: Kegagalan upstream, gambar tiada atau respons bukan imej menghasilkan silhouette lokal tanpa OpaqueResponseBlocking pada browser.
items.en_draft: Upstream failure, no image or non-image response produces a local silhouette without OpaqueResponseBlocking on the browser.

items.bm: Menu Back to My Account dalam Administrator kini menggunakan warna kuning yang sama dengan menu Administrator pada dashboard pengguna.
items.en_draft: The Back to My Account menu in the Administrator now uses the same yellow color as the Administrator menu on the user dashboard.

items.bm: Warna normal, hover dan focus menggunakan class pill-yellow sedia ada tanpa mengubah navigasi atau authorization.
items.en_draft: Normal color, hover and focus use the existing pill-yellow class without changing navigation or authorization.

items.bm: Audit induk Admin Step-Up 2FA kini menyatukan keperluan Configuration, SC7-SC8, Password Recovery, token lifecycle dan Active Sessions.
items.en_draft: Admin Step-Up 2FA master audit now consolidates Configuration, SC7-SC8, Password Recovery, token lifecycle and Active Sessions requirements.

items.bm: Purpose ADMIN_ACCESS, SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE dan ACTIVE_SESSION_REVOCATION diasingkan dengan kontrak authorization fail-closed.
items.en_draft: Purpose ADMIN_ACCESS, SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE and ACTIVE_SESSION_REVOCATION are separated by a fail-closed authorization contract.

items.bm: Dokumen meliputi controlled bootstrap, encrypted TOTP lifecycle, structured rejection, break-glass, session revocation, UAT, monitoring dan rollout gate.
items.en_draft: Documents cover controlled bootstrap, encrypted TOTP lifecycle, structured rejection, break-glass, session revocation, UAT, monitoring and rollout gate.

items.bm: Kontrak dokumentasi SC7 memastikan audit induk dan dokumen handoff berkaitan kekal selaras; implementasi masih on hold.
items.en_draft: The SC7 documentation contract ensures that master audits and related handoff documents remain consistent; implementation is still on hold.

items.bm: Pagination Audit History kini sepadan dengan Active Sessions dan berada di kanan bawah pada desktop.
items.en_draft: Pagination Audit History now matches Active Sessions and is in the bottom right of the desktop.

items.bm: Ruang selepas jadual, saiz butang, hover, focus dan disabled state diseragamkan untuk paparan yang lebih kemas.
items.en_draft: The space after the table, button size, hover, focus and disabled state are standardized for a neater display.

items.bm: Pada skrin kecil pagination kembali ke tengah bagi mengekalkan kawalan yang mudah dicapai.
items.en_draft: On small screens pagination returns to the center to maintain easy-to-reach controls.

items.bm: Audit History dipadatkan daripada tujuh kolum kepada empat kumpulan maklumat yang mudah diimbas.
items.en_draft: Audit History is condensed from seven columns to four information groups that are easy to scan.

items.bm: Semua header dan data audit menggunakan top-left alignment, lebar kolum stabil, ellipsis serta tooltip bagi reason yang panjang.
items.en_draft: All headers and audit data use top-left alignment, stable column width, ellipsis and tooltip for a long reason.

items.bm: Outcome, revision, perubahan, actor, reason code dan reference disusun secara hierarki dengan paparan responsif seperti Active Sessions.
items.en_draft: Outcome, revision, change, actor, reason code and reference are organized hierarchically with a responsive display such as Active Sessions.

items.bm: Configuration kini menggunakan tiga tab khusus: Authentication Policy, Account Recovery dan Audit History.
items.en_draft: Configuration now uses three specific tabs: Authentication Policy, Account Recovery and Audit History.

items.bm: Setiap tab mengekalkan form serta kawalan keselamatan sedia ada sambil mengurangkan panjang halaman dan memudahkan navigasi.
items.en_draft: Each tab maintains existing forms and security controls while reducing page length and simplifying navigation.

items.bm: Tab responsif boleh discroll pada skrin kecil, menggunakan status aksesibiliti tab, dan memuat semula audit history apabila dibuka.
items.en_draft: Responsive tabs can be scrolled on a small screen, use the tab's accessibility status, and refresh the audit history when opened.

items.bm: Fasa 3 Configuration kini mewajibkan change reason dan mengikat setiap preview kepada configuration_version semasa.
items.en_draft: Phase 3 Configuration now requires a change reason and binds each preview to the current configuration_version.

items.bm: Optimistic locking menolak Apply daripada preview lama supaya perubahan dua admin tidak boleh saling menindih tanpa amaran.
items.en_draft: Optimistic locking rejects Apply from old previews so that changes from two admins can't overlap each other without warning.

items.bm: Structured Configuration History merekod success/rejection, actor, revision, before/after, reason code, change reason dan correlation tanpa token atau credential.
items.en_draft: Structured Configuration History records success/rejection, actor, revision, before/after, reason code, change reason and correlation without tokens or credentials.

items.bm: Halaman Configuration memaparkan Last Changed serta history read-only newest-first dengan pagination.
items.en_draft: The Configuration page displays Last Changed and newest-first read-only history with pagination.

items.bm: Forward/down migration dan concurrency contract tersedia; activation staging memerlukan migration check/apply sebelum reload PHP-FPM.
items.en_draft: Forward/down migration and concurrency contract available; activation staging requires a migration check/apply before reloading PHP-FPM.

items.bm: Semua nama dan kandungan dokumen release aktif telah diaudit supaya menggunakan penomboran baharu; nombor legacy hanya dikekalkan dalam jadual migrasi rasmi.
items.en_draft: All active release document names and contents have been audited to use the new numbering; legacy numbers are only retained in official migration tables.

items.bm: Contract dokumentasi baharu menolak nama fail atau kandungan Markdown yang memperkenalkan semula release 2.0.5 dan ke atas di luar polisi migrasi.
items.en_draft: The new documentation contract excludes filenames or Markdown content that reintroduces release 2.0.5 and above outside the migration policy.

items.bm: Dokumen release lama kini menggunakan canonical path v2.1.0 hingga v2.1.3 mengikut urutan release sebenar.
items.en_draft: Old release documents now use the canonical path v2.1.0 to v2.1.3 according to the actual release order.

items.bm: Metadata pusat dan package.json kini menggunakan v2.4.1, release pertama selepas baseline normalisasi v2.4.0.
items.en_draft: Central metadata and package.json now use v2.4.1, the first release after the v2.4.0 normalization baseline.

items.bm: Penomboran dependency pihak ketiga dan alamat IP bertitik tidak dianggap sebagai versi aplikasi OneID.
items.en_draft: Third-party dependency numbering and dotted IP addresses are not considered OneID application versions.

items.bm: Penomboran release 2.x dinormalisasi kepada lima patch setiap minor: .0 hingga .4, kemudian minor seterusnya bermula semula pada .0.
items.en_draft: The 2.x release numbering is normalized to five patches per minor: .0 to .4, then the next minor starts again at .0.

items.bm: Browser UAT AS2 bagi multi_session=1, revoked token tanpa perubahan polisi global dan multi_session=0 telah dilaporkan PASS oleh owner.
items.en_draft: Browser UAT AS2 for multi_session=1, revoked token without global policy change and multi_session=0 has been reported PASS by the owner.

items.bm: UAT mengesahkan multiple session berfungsi apabila dibenarkan dan browser lama memerlukan login semula selepas token ditamatkan.
items.en_draft: UAT verifies multiple sessions work when allowed and older browsers require re-login after the token expires.

items.bm: AS3 notification, idle warning, absolute-timeout warning dan revoked reason direkod sebagai UX follow-up yang ditangguhkan oleh owner.
items.en_draft: AS3 notification, idle warning, absolute-timeout warning and revoked reason are recorded as UX follow-up that is postponed by the owner.

items.bm: Hard session cap, Controlled Admin Revoke, housekeeping Apply, retention 90 hari, monitoring dan penamatan compatibility refresh kekal pending dengan gate berasingan.
items.en_draft: Hard session cap, Controlled Admin Revoke, housekeeping Apply, 90 day retention, monitoring and termination compatibility refresh remains pending with a separate gate.

items.bm: Release ini menutup evidence dan dokumentasi UAT AS2 tanpa mengubah database, runtime configuration atau enforcement yang telah lulus.
items.en_draft: This release closes the evidence and documentation of UAT AS2 without changing the database, runtime configuration or enforcement that has passed.

items.bm: Setiap action OneID yang terlindung kini mengikat PHP session kepada cookie SSO token yang masih aktif untuk pengguna tersebut.
items.en_draft: Each protected OneID action now binds the PHP session to the SSO token cookie that is still active for that user.

items.bm: Apabila login baharu merevoke token lama semasa multiple session dimatikan, browser lama menerima HTTP 401 pada action atau heartbeat seterusnya.
items.en_draft: When the new login revokes the old token while the multiple session is turned off, the old browser receives an HTTP 401 on the next action or heartbeat.

items.bm: Revoked browser membersihkan cookie SSO, authenticated session state dan merotasi PHP session ID sebelum kembali ke login.
items.en_draft: Revoked browser clears the SSO cookie, authenticated session state and rotates the PHP session ID before returning to login.

items.bm: Dashboard user, dashboard admin dan report user list turut menolak direct page access menggunakan token yang telah tidak aktif.
items.en_draft: The user dashboard, admin dashboard and report user list also reject direct page access using tokens that have been inactive.

items.bm: Dokumen AS2 merekodkan baki UAT dua browser/PC, hard session cap, Admin Revoke, housekeeping, retention dan monitoring sebagai gate berasingan.
items.en_draft: Document AS2 records the remaining UAT of two browsers/PCs, hard session cap, Admin Revoke, housekeeping, retention and monitoring as separate gates.

items.bm: Jadual Admin Active Sessions kini memastikan setiap nilai Issued At, Last Heartbeat, User, Device dan Status dipaparkan dalam satu baris.
items.en_draft: The Admin Active Sessions table now ensures that each Issued At, Last Heartbeat, User, Device and Status values ​​are displayed in one row.

items.bm: Kolum User hanya memaparkan nama; ID/IC penuh kekal tersedia melalui tooltip apabila tetikus berada di atas nama.
items.en_draft: The User column only displays the name; The full ID/IC remains available via a tooltip when the mouse is over the name.

items.bm: Nilai panjang menggunakan ellipsis tanpa mengubah tinggi row, dan kandungan penuh bagi masa serta peranti kekal tersedia melalui tooltip.
items.en_draft: Long values ​​use ellipsis without changing the row height, and the full content of time and device remains available via the tooltip.

items.bm: Masa revocation untuk status Grace atau Due dipindahkan ke tooltip status supaya badge kekal satu baris.
items.en_draft: The revocation time for Grace or Due status is moved to the status tooltip so that the badge remains one line.

items.bm: Contract AS0 melindungi paparan nama sahaja dan memastikan detail sensitif yang diperlukan tidak diwujudkan sebagai baris kedua.
items.en_draft: Contract AS0 protects the display of name only and ensures that the required sensitive details are not created as a second line.

items.bm: Heartbeat teknikal lima minit kini mengekalkan liveness token tanpa memperbaharui idle activity PHP; idle 30 minit dan absolute timeout 8 jam kekal berasingan.
items.en_draft: The five-minute technical heartbeat now maintains token liveness without renewing idle PHP activity; idle 30 minutes and absolute timeout 8 hours remain separate.

items.bm: Admin Active Sessions menambah state Refresh Window dan metrik Current, Active, Refresh, Grace, Due serta Expired.
items.en_draft: Admin Active Sessions adds state Refresh Window and metrics Current, Active, Refresh, Grace, Due and Expired.

items.bm: Timestamp UI diperjelas sebagai Issued At dan Last Heartbeat, selari dengan lifecycle absolute token dan compatibility window 60 minit.
items.en_draft: The UI timestamp is clarified as Issued At and Last Heartbeat, in line with the token's absolute lifecycle and compatibility window of 60 minutes.

items.bm: Tool housekeeping menyediakan mod --check read-only serta Apply fail-closed dengan batch 500, advisory lock, transaction, typed confirmation dan exact reconciliation.
items.en_draft: The housekeeping tool provides --check read-only mode as well as Apply fail-closed with batch 500, advisory lock, transaction, typed confirmation and exact reconciliation.

items.bm: Housekeeping Apply, retention purge, cron scheduler, hard multi-session cap dan controlled admin revoke kekal disabled sehingga gate operasi masing-masing diluluskan.
items.en_draft: Housekeeping Apply, retention purge, cron scheduler, hard multi-session cap and controlled admin revoke remain disabled until their respective operation gates are approved.

items.bm: Admin Active Sessions kini menggunakan listing read-only sebenar; Refresh, carian, filter dan pagination tidak lagi menukar status token secara tersembunyi.
items.en_draft: Admin Active Sessions now uses real read-only listings; Refresh, search, filter and pagination no longer change token status incognito.

items.bm: Response browser menggunakan explicit projection tanpa token_id, token hash atau policy correlation material.
items.en_draft: Browser response uses explicit projection without token_id, token hash or policy correlation material.

items.bm: Lifecycle sesi membezakan Current, Active, Grace, Due dan Expired berdasarkan absolute issuance serta jadual revocation SC5.
items.en_draft: The session lifecycle differentiates Current, Active, Grace, Due and Expired based on absolute issuance and revocation table SC5.

items.bm: UI memisahkan Issued At daripada Last Activity serta menambah carian pengguna/peranti, status filter dan page size 10, 25 atau 50.
items.en_draft: The UI separates Issued At from Last Activity and adds user/device search, filter status and page size 10, 25 or 50.

items.bm: Contract dan preflight AS0 mengesahkan bounded query, zero mutation dan forbidden-field protection; controlled revoke kekal deferred sehingga Admin Step-Up tersedia.
items.en_draft: Contract and AS0 preflight confirm bounded query, zero mutation and forbidden-field protection; controlled revoke remains deferred until Admin Step-Up is available.

items.bm: Konfigurasi dan secrets kini menggunakan satu runtime file resolver; ONEID_SECRETS_FILE kekal sebagai alias legacy tetapi path bercanggah akan ditolak.
items.en_draft: Configuration and secrets now use a runtime file resolver; ONEID_SECRETS_FILE remains a legacy alias but conflicting paths will be rejected.

items.bm: Tool configuration_audit.php memeriksa 66 key, duplicate source key, permission, URL, timezone, SMTP, API, credentials dan mode Sync secara read-only.
items.en_draft: The configuration_audit.php tool checks 66 keys, duplicate source keys, permission, URL, timezone, SMTP, API, credentials and Sync mode in a read-only manner.

items.bm: Template private runtime dikemas kini dan disusun mengikut kumpulan Application, API, database, SMTP, Sync, external source dan diagnostics.
items.en_draft: The private runtime template is updated and organized according to Application, API, database, SMTP, Sync, external source and diagnostics groups.

items.bm: Template Nginx serta PHP-FPM UAT diselaraskan kepada project path staging /var/www/oneid-uat.
items.en_draft: The Nginx and PHP-FPM UAT templates are aligned to the staging project path /var/www/oneid-uat.

items.bm: Configuration contract membuktikan resolver fail-closed, template lengkap, audit tanpa mutation dan perlindungan private/public kekal lulus.
items.en_draft: Configuration contract proves file-closed resolver, complete template, audit without mutation and private/public protection remains passed.

items.bm: Operational Sync kini menggunakan soft warning bagi New melebihi 500, Update melebihi 1,000, Reactivate melebihi 100 atau jumlah perubahan melebihi 1,500.
items.en_draft: Operational Sync now uses a soft warning for New exceeding 500, Update exceeding 1,000, Reactivating exceeding 100 or total changes exceeding 1,500.

items.bm: Batch besar kekal boleh di-Apply selepas semakan dan typed confirmation yang mengikat exact New, Update, Deactivate, Reactivate serta plan hash.
items.en_draft: Large batches can still be applied after review and typed confirmation that binds exact New, Update, Deactivate, Reactivate and plan hash.

items.bm: Deactivate melebihi 50 disekat pada preview dan server Apply; plan tersebut mesti melalui Controlled Full Sync dengan kelulusan khusus.
items.en_draft: Deactivate over 50 is blocked on the preview and Apply server; the plan must go through Controlled Full Sync with special approval.

items.bm: Nilai ambang boleh ditetapkan dalam private runtime, divalidasi secara ketat dan dipaparkan oleh preflight tanpa mendedahkan rahsia.
items.en_draft: Threshold values ​​can be set in private runtime, strictly validated and displayed by preflight without revealing secrets.

items.bm: Runbook dan characterization contract dikemas kini untuk membezakan batch biasa, batch besar dan hard block.
items.en_draft: Runbook and contract characterization updated to distinguish normal batch, large batch and hard block.

items.bm: Identiti IC/pasport pelajar dinormalisasi kepada format alfanumerik tanpa ruang atau sengkang sebelum Preview dan Apply.
items.en_draft: IC identity/student passport is normalized to alphanumeric format without spaces or dashes before Preview and Apply.

items.bm: Matching planner menggunakan identiti canonical pada snapshot external dan akaun sedia ada supaya cleanup menghasilkan Update pada matrik sama, bukan Deactivate dan New.
items.en_draft: Matching planner uses canonical identity on external snapshot and existing account so that cleanup produces Update on the same matrix, not Deactivate and New.

items.bm: Dry-run read-only terhadap 6,485 source rows menghasilkan tepat 137 Update pada data2, tanpa New, Deactivate atau Reactivate.
items.en_draft: Dry-run read-only against 6,485 source rows produces exactly 137 Updates on data2, without New, Deactivate or Reactivate.

items.bm: Dua akaun staf dengan ID alternatif yang telah disahkan kekal tidak disentuh oleh cleanup khusus Pelajar.
items.en_draft: Two staff accounts with verified alternative IDs remain untouched by the Student-specific cleanup.

items.bm: Protected manual collision matching turut menerima bentuk identiti canonical supaya akaun manual kekal fail-closed selepas normalisasi.
items.en_draft: Protected manual collision matching also accepts a canonical identity form so that the manual account remains file-closed after normalization.

items.bm: Operational External Sync membolehkan Administrator menjalankan Apply berulang selepas fresh preview tanpa count/hash private baharu atau full database dump bagi setiap batch biasa.
items.en_draft: Operational External Sync allows Administrator to run Apply repeatedly after fresh preview without new private count/hash or full database dump for each normal batch.

items.bm: Setiap Apply kekal diikat kepada approval session sekali guna, exact plan fingerprint, admin aktif dan expiry 5 minit; fresh snapshot mesti sepadan sebelum transaction bermula.
items.en_draft: Each Apply remains tied to a one-time approval session, exact fingerprint plan, active admin and 5-minute expiry; fresh snapshot must match before transaction starts.

items.bm: Plan yang mempunyai Deactivate memerlukan typed confirmation dengan exact Deactivate count, manakala source anomaly, collision, invalid rows dan blast-radius threshold terus menyekat Apply.
items.en_draft: Plans that have Deactivate require typed confirmation with exact Deactivate count, while source anomaly, collision, invalid rows and blast-radius threshold continue to block Apply.

items.bm: Writer selamat mengekalkan advisory lock, transaction, reconciliation dan audit marker; Operational, Pilot dan Full Cutover tidak boleh aktif serentak.
items.en_draft: Writer safely maintains advisory lock, transaction, reconciliation and audit markers; Operational, Pilot and Full Cutover cannot be active at the same time.

items.bm: Preflight dan runbook S4G ditambah untuk activation sekali sahaja, operasi setiap batch, backup berjadual serta disable segera melalui private runtime.
items.en_draft: Preflight and S4G runbook added for one-time activation, operation of each batch, scheduled backup and immediate disable via private runtime.

items.bm: Pengurusan kategori Web Apps kini menyediakan tindakan Edit untuk membetulkan nama kategori dengan validation, duplicate protection, transaction dan audit log yang wajib.
items.en_draft: The Web Apps category management now provides an Edit action to correct the category name with mandatory validation, duplicate protection, transaction and audit logs.

items.bm: Modal Edit Category kembali ke Manage Categories selepas Cancel, tutup atau simpan supaya aliran kerja pentadbir kekal lancar.
items.en_draft: Modal Edit Category returns to Manage Categories after Cancel, close or save so that the admin workflow remains smooth.

items.bm: Kolum nombor pada External Sync Log dilebarkan dan dikekalkan pada satu baris untuk menyokong nombor sehingga tiga digit.
items.en_draft: The number column on the External Sync Log is expanded and kept on one line to support numbers up to three digits.

items.bm: Logo header pengguna dan pentadbir dikemas kini kepada identiti UPNM 30 Tahun menggunakan aset PNG tempatan tanpa kebergantungan kepada pelayan luar.
items.en_draft: User and administrator header logo updated to UPNM 30 Year identity using local PNG assets without dependency on external servers.

items.bm: Full External Sync yang diluluskan selesai dengan reconciliation tepat: 70 New, 33 Update, 1 Deactivate dan 0 Reactivate; runtime Apply dikembalikan kepada disabled selepas operasi.
items.en_draft: Approved Full External Sync completed with accurate reconciliation: 70 New, 33 Update, 1 Deactivate and 0 Reactivate; the Apply runtime is returned to disabled after the operation.

items.bm: Fasa S4F Full External Sync menyediakan endpoint dan UI Apply berasingan yang kekal disabled secara default serta hanya tersedia dalam maintenance window yang diluluskan.
items.en_draft: The S4F Full External Sync phase provides a separate Apply endpoint and UI that remains disabled by default and is only available in an approved maintenance window.

items.bm: Full Apply diikat kepada exact New, Update, Deactivate dan Reactivate counts, full 64-character plan hash, admin session, approval sekali guna dan typed confirmation.
items.en_draft: Full Apply is tied to exact New, Update, Deactivate and Reactivate counts, full 64-character plan hash, admin session, one-time approval and typed confirmation.

items.bm: Writer mengambil fresh external snapshot sebelum transaction, mengesahkan semula plan, menggunakan advisory lock dan mewajibkan transaction serta reconciliation audit sebelum commit.
items.en_draft: Writer takes a fresh external snapshot before the transaction, reconfirms the plan, uses an advisory lock and requires the transaction and reconciliation audit before committing.

items.bm: Preflight, post-run result audit, characterization contract, cutover/rollback runbook dan gate register ditambah untuk operasi full sync yang fail-closed.
items.en_draft: Preflight, post-run result audit, characterization contract, cutover/rollback runbook and gate register are added for fail-closed full sync operation.

items.bm: Semakan private menerima 33 Update dan 1 Deactivate; backup baharu disahkan melalui checksum serta isolated restore 18 jadual tanpa mengubah source database.
items.en_draft: Private review received 33 Updates and 1 Deactivate; The new backup is verified through checksum as well as isolated restore of 18 tables without changing the source database.

items.bm: Keserasian Chrome dan Firefox dipertingkat dengan atribut autocomplete, username tersembunyi serta identiti medan yang lengkap untuk login, password recovery, OTP dan pertukaran kata laluan.
items.en_draft: Chrome and Firefox compatibility is enhanced with the autocomplete attribute, hidden usernames and complete identity fields for login, password recovery, OTP and password change.

items.bm: Content Security Policy, cookie pihak ketiga dan logo MyDigital ID diperbaiki dengan polisi aktif serta aset logo tempatan untuk mengelakkan warning dan permintaan luaran.
items.en_draft: Content Security Policy, third-party cookies and MyDigital ID logo are improved with active policies and local logo assets to avoid warnings and external requests.

items.bm: CSS login, dashboard pengguna dan dashboard pentadbir dibersihkan daripada selector, prefix, filter dan at-rule browser legacy yang tidak lagi sah tanpa mengubah fungsi antaramuka.
items.en_draft: CSS login, user dashboard and administrator dashboard are cleaned of selectors, prefixes, filters and legacy browser at-rules that are no longer valid without changing the functionality of the interface.

items.bm: Aset ikon dan font diperkemas, termasuk Font Awesome, Icomoon, Dropify dan font dashboard, bagi menghapuskan warning parser serta glyph dalam browser moden.
items.en_draft: Streamlined icon and font assets, including Font Awesome, Icomoon, Dropify and dashboard fonts, to eliminate parser warnings and glyphs in modern browsers.

items.bm: Modal password, label borang, input OTP dan pemuatan halaman diperbaiki untuk accessibility, autofill serta prestasi layout yang lebih konsisten.
items.en_draft: Modal password, form label, OTP input and page loading are improved for accessibility, autofill and more consistent layout performance.

items.bm: Dashboard pengguna dan Administrator kini memaparkan pecahan Jumlah, Full SSO dan Non SSO berdasarkan aplikasi unik serta kontrak sp_sso_support yang sama dengan tindakan akses.
items.en_draft: User and Administrator dashboards now display Total, Full SSO and Non SSO breakdowns based on unique applications and sp_sso_support contracts that are the same as access actions.

items.bm: Kad ringkasan aplikasi menggunakan identiti warna berbeza dan susun atur responsive, termasuk state loading, kosong dan kegagalan data.
items.en_draft: The application summary card uses a different color identity and responsive layout, including state loading, empty and data failure.

items.bm: Audit Fasa 7 Admin Step-Up 2FA diperluas dengan pilihan OTP e-mel atau Microsoft Authenticator melalui TOTP, server-side enforcement, enrollment, recovery dan audit tanpa melaksanakan feature tersebut lagi.
items.en_draft: Phase 7 Audit Admin Step-Up 2FA is expanded with the option of email OTP or Microsoft Authenticator via TOTP, server-side enforcement, enrollment, recovery and audit without implementing the feature again.
