items.bm: Audit serta pelan pelaksanaan multi-language Bahasa Melayu dan English disusun dalam ML0 hingga ML9 meliputi Configuration default language, preference pengguna, UI, API, e-mel, accessibility, metadata, UAT dan rollback.
items.en_draft: The audit and multi-language Bahasa Melayu and English implementation plan are organized in ML0 to ML9 covering Configuration default language, user preferences, UI, API, e-mail, accessibility, metadata, UAT and rollback.

items.bm: Konfigurasi SSO pentadbir diperkukuh melalui validation, audit correlation, integriti database, token lifecycle dan pemisahan polisi Password Recovery.
items.en_draft: Administrator SSO configuration is strengthened through validation, audit correlation, database integrity, token lifecycle and separation of Password Recovery policies.

items.bm: Penghantaran test email dan OTP Password Recovery telah disahkan sehingga mailbox; OTP kekal sah 5 minit dan hanya boleh digunakan sekali.
items.en_draft: Email test delivery and OTP Password Recovery have been confirmed to the mailbox; The OTP remains valid for 5 minutes and can only be used once.

items.bm: Aliran Tukar Kata Laluan kini memberikan feedback SweetAlert/toast yang jelas, mengesahkan password semasa dan kualiti password, merotasi session serta membatalkan session/token lain.
items.en_draft: The Change Password flow now provides clear SweetAlert/toast feedback, confirms the current password and password quality, rotates sessions and cancels other sessions/tokens.

items.bm: Halaman login memaparkan logo MyDigital ID sebagai preview tanpa mengaktifkan fungsi authentication baharu.
items.en_draft: The login page displays the MyDigital ID logo as a preview without activating the new authentication function.

items.bm: Admin Web Apps Add/Edit kini menggunakan validation HTTPS, App ID kriptografi, confirmation, double-submit protection, atomic persistence dan audit correlation.
items.en_draft: Admin Web Apps Add/Edit now uses HTTPS validation, App ID cryptography, confirmation, double-submit protection, atomic persistence and audit correlation.

items.bm: Admin Web Apps kini mempunyai carian semua aplikasi merentas kategori berdasarkan nama, fungsi, URL dan App ID, dengan kiraan hasil serta clear action.
items.en_draft: Admin Web Apps now has search all apps across categories based on name, function, URL and App ID, with result count and clear action.

items.bm: Icon Web Apps disimpan mengikut environment local/staging walaupun database dikongsi; setiap filesystem kekal berasingan dan missing asset jatuh kepada placeholder.
items.en_draft: Icon Web Apps are stored according to the local/staging environment even though the database is shared; each filesystem remains separate and missing assets fall to placeholders.

items.bm: Upload icon baharu didecode dan dinormalisasi kepada static PNG 256×256; metadata dibuang, animated image dan input melebihi had keselamatan ditolak.
items.en_draft: Upload new icon decoded and normalized to static PNG 256×256; metadata is removed, animated image and input exceeding the security limit is rejected.

items.bm: Login dan Password Recovery kini mempunyai request timeout, double-submit protection, session-lock release, correlation audit serta feedback SweetAlert apabila respons tergendala.
items.en_draft: Login and Password Recovery now have request timeout, double-submit protection, session-lock release, correlation audit and SweetAlert feedback when the response is delayed.

items.bm: WA6 menyediakan reconciliation read-only dengan SHA-256 bagi missing reference dan orphan candidate; tiada quarantine atau deletion dibenarkan tanpa kelulusan owner.
items.en_draft: WA6 provides read-only reconciliation with SHA-256 for missing reference and orphan candidate; no quarantine or deletion is allowed without the owner's approval.

items.bm: Controlled Pilot External Sync berjaya melaksanakan subset terkawal 2 akaun baharu dan 1 kemas kini tanpa Deactivate atau Reactivate; Apply kemudiannya dikembalikan kepada disabled.
items.en_draft: Controlled Pilot External Sync successfully executed a controlled subset of 2 new accounts and 1 update without Deactivate or Reactivate; Apply is then returned to disabled.

items.bm: Backup penuh oneiddb, restore rehearsal dan isolated pilot rehearsal disahkan melalui checksum, row reconciliation serta cleanup database sementara tanpa mengubah sumber.
items.en_draft: Full oneiddb backup, restore rehearsal and isolated pilot rehearsal are confirmed through checksum, row reconciliation and temporary database cleanup without changing the source.

items.bm: Struktur deployment memisahkan public root, konfigurasi runtime persekitaran dan secret store di dalam direktori projek tetapi di luar capaian web.
items.en_draft: The deployment structure separates the public root, environment runtime configuration and secret store inside the project directory but out of web reach.

items.bm: Semua notifikasi aplikasi distandardkan sebagai toast top-right; native alert diganti dengan toast dan tindakan berisiko menggunakan SweetAlert confirmation.
items.en_draft: All application notifications are standardized as toast top-right; native alerts are replaced with toasts and risky actions using SweetAlert confirmation.

items.bm: Audit Log kini menyediakan pagination 10 rekod setiap halaman serta date picker yang lebih padat dengan Apply dan Cancel di bawah kalendar.
items.en_draft: Audit Log now provides pagination of 10 records per page as well as a more compact date picker with Apply and Cancel under the calendar.

items.bm: Aset CSS legacy yang tidak digunakan dibuang daripada dashboard untuk mengurangkan warning browser tanpa mengubah Dropify, SweetAlert atau fungsi aktif.
items.en_draft: Unused legacy CSS assets are removed from the dashboard to reduce browser warnings without changing Dropify, SweetAlert or active functionality.

items.bm: Paparan Version Releases kini menggunakan accordion eksklusif: release terkini terbuka secara default dan hanya satu release dipaparkan pada satu masa.
items.en_draft: The Version Releases view now uses an exclusive accordion: the latest release is open by default and only one release is displayed at a time.

items.bm: Audit Log kini memaparkan rekod terbaharu di bahagian paling atas menggunakan susunan stabil datetime DESC, id DESC.
items.en_draft: Audit Log now displays the most recent record at the top using a stable order of datetime DESC, id DESC.

items.bm: Jika beberapa aktiviti direkod pada saat yang sama, ID audit terbaharu menentukan susunan supaya paparan tidak berubah-ubah selepas reload.
items.en_draft: If several activities are recorded at the same time, the most recent audit ID determines the order so that the display does not change after a reload.

items.bm: Julat tarikh Audit Log kini merangkumi keseluruhan hari akhir yang dipilih dan tidak lagi berhenti pada jam 00:00:00.
items.en_draft: The Audit Log date range now spans the entire selected end day and no longer stops at 00:00:00.

items.bm: UI melaksanakan susunan defensif selepas data dimuatkan, manakala database kekal sebagai source of truth untuk urutan dan had 50 rekod terkini.
items.en_draft: The UI performs a defensive order after the data is loaded, while the database remains the source of truth for the sequence and the limit of 50 latest records.

items.bm: Dashboard pengguna kini mempunyai carian aplikasi merentas kategori berdasarkan nama dan fungsi aplikasi, dengan kategori padanan dipilih secara automatik.
items.en_draft: The user dashboard now has a cross-category application search based on application name and function, with matching categories automatically selected.

items.bm: Tab Favourite berikon bintang ditambah pada kedudukan pertama untuk mengumpulkan aplikasi yang kerap digunakan tanpa mengeluarkannya daripada kategori asal.
items.en_draft: A Favorite tab with a star icon is added in the first position to group frequently used applications without removing them from the original category.

items.bm: Pilihan Favourite disimpan secara persistent mengikut akaun melalui jadual preference khusus dan kekal selepas logout atau login semula.
items.en_draft: Favorites are saved persistently by account through a specific preference table and remain after logout or login again.

items.bm: Favourite dikawal oleh session dan effective ACL; preference tidak menambah akses serta tidak boleh memintas category allow, direct allow atau blacklist deny.
items.en_draft: Favorites are controlled by session and effective ACL; preference does not add access and cannot bypass category allow, direct allow or blacklist deny.

items.bm: Setiap kad aplikasi kini menyediakan tindakan Favourite berkeadaan kelabu/kuning dan tindakan akses yang lebih jelas serta responsive.
items.en_draft: Each application card now provides a gray/yellow Favorite action and a more clear and responsive access action.

items.bm: Aplikasi OneID SSO menggunakan label Login, manakala aplikasi NON SSO menggunakan label Akses dan badge Akses terus.
items.en_draft: The OneID SSO application uses the Login label, while the NON SSO application uses the Access label and the Direct Access badge.

items.bm: Tab NON SSO diberi identiti warna berbeza supaya pautan terus mudah dibezakan daripada aplikasi berintegrasi OneID.
items.en_draft: The NON SSO tab is given a different color identity so that direct links are easily distinguished from OneID integrated applications.

items.bm: Migration, rollback, characterization contract dan runbook UAT U1 ditambah; smoke HTTP, structure, M2, M3 dan release regression kekal lulus.
items.en_draft: Migration, rollback, characterization contract and UAT U1 runbook added; smoke HTTP, structure, M2, M3 and release regression remain passed.

items.bm: Gate live Apply-path M1 direkod sebagai ditangguhkan oleh owner sehingga akaun external ujian yang sesuai tersedia; penangguhan ini tidak mengaktifkan External Sync Apply S4E.
items.en_draft: Gate live Apply-path M1 is recorded as delayed by the owner until a suitable test external account is available; this delay does not activate External Sync Apply S4E.

items.bm: Paparan Version Releases dihadkan kepada 10 versi terkini dan menyediakan tindakan untuk melihat release terdahulu secara berperingkat.
items.en_draft: The Version Releases display is limited to the 10 latest versions and provides an action to view previous releases in stages.

items.bm: Direktori admin kini hanya memaparkan tab kategori yang mempunyai aplikasi aktif; inventori penuh dan sebab kategori tidak boleh dipadam tersedia melalui Manage Categories.
items.en_draft: The admin directory now only displays category tabs that have active applications; The full inventory and reasons why categories cannot be deleted are available through Manage Categories.

items.bm: Kategori sistem dilindungi dan kategori berisi tidak boleh dipadam; create/delete menggunakan validation, transaction, rollback serta correlated audit trail.
items.en_draft: System categories are protected and filled categories cannot be deleted; create/delete using validation, transaction, rollback and correlated audit trail.

items.bm: Remove App kini mengarkib aplikasi ke kategori sistem dan membersihkan group ACL, direct ACL, blacklist serta Favourite secara atomic; aplikasi inactive ditolak oleh effective ACL.
items.en_draft: Remove App now archives applications to the system category and cleans group ACL, direct ACL, blacklist and Favorites atomically; inactive applications are rejected by effective ACL.

items.bm: Integriti schema diperkukuh dengan nama kategori unik dan foreign key sp_list.sp_group_id berpolisi ON DELETE RESTRICT.
items.en_draft: Schema integrity is reinforced with unique category names and foreign keys sp_list.sp_group_id with an ON DELETE RESTRICT policy.

items.bm: Profile Save, category policy dan ACL hardening disiapkan melalui fasa M3 dengan validation, explicit confirmation, transaction, rollback dan correlated audit trail.
items.en_draft: Profile Save, category policy and ACL hardening are completed through phase M3 with validation, explicit confirmation, transaction, rollback and correlated audit trail.

items.bm: Butang Save Profile kini menjadi satu-satunya laluan menyimpan nama dan kategori; perubahan dropdown tidak lagi terus mengubah database.
items.en_draft: The Save Profile button is now the only way to save names and categories; dropdown changes no longer continue to change the database.

items.bm: Nama akaun external-managed dijadikan read-only dan hanya boleh dikemas kini melalui Safe Resync, manakala nama akaun manual boleh disimpan selepas validation.
items.en_draft: External-managed account names are made read-only and can only be updated via Safe Resync, while manual account names can be saved after validation.

items.bm: Kategori pengguna dipisahkan daripada role administrator; hardcoded category ID 9 dan mutator category/role legacy telah dibuang supaya u_type sentiasa dikekalkan.
items.en_draft: The user category is separated from the administrator role; hardcoded category ID 9 and category/role legacy mutator have been removed so that u_type is always preserved.

items.bm: ACL khusus pengguna untuk Allow, Deny dan Uplift kini mengesahkan user, aplikasi, duplicate state dan ownership deny record sebelum mutation.
items.en_draft: User-specific ACLs for Allow, Deny and Uplift now verify user, application, duplicate state and ownership deny record before mutation.

items.bm: Perubahan kategori dan ACL membatalkan sesi aktif pengguna supaya policy baharu berkuat kuasa serta-merta.
items.en_draft: Category and ACL changes cancel the user's active session so that the new policy takes effect immediately.

items.bm: Nama aplikasi dinyahkod secara selamat sebelum dimasukkan ke DOM dan kegagalan AJAX kini memaparkan code serta correlation reference.
items.en_draft: The application name is safely decoded before being entered into the DOM and AJAX failure now displays the code and correlation reference.

items.bm: Manual UAT profile/category, Forbidden admin route, ACL allow/deny/uplift, session revocation dan Audit Log telah disahkan lulus menggunakan akaun ujian terkawal.
items.en_draft: Manual UAT profile/category, Forbidden admin route, ACL allow/deny/uplift, session revocation and Audit Log have been confirmed to pass using a controlled test account.

items.bm: Defense-in-depth consumer turut disahkan: direct allow OneID tidak memintas authorization dalaman aplikasi sasaran.
items.en_draft: Defense-in-depth consumer is also confirmed: direct allow OneID does not bypass the internal authorization of the target application.

items.bm: Menyelaraskan identiti release kepada Version 2.0.2 melalui satu source metadata untuk login, dashboard pengguna, dashboard admin, footer dan latest release badge.
items.en_draft: Coordinate the release identity to Version 2.0.2 through one metadata source for login, user dashboard, admin dashboard, footer and latest release badge.

items.bm: Copyright aplikasi distandardkan kepada 2026 © PTMK | Aplikasi Digital pada semua paparan utama.
items.en_draft: Application copyright is standardized to 2026 © PTMK | Digital Applicationon all main displays.

items.bm: UI Version Releases dibina semula menggunakan release cards, metadata release dan changelog yang lebih tersusun serta responsive.
items.en_draft: The Version Releases UI has been rebuilt using release cards, release metadata and a more organized and responsive changelog.

items.bm: UI SSO Configuration, Sync Log, Audit Log, Active Sessions, User Accounts, Web Apps dan dashboard pengguna disusun semula dengan hierarchy, compact table/card serta responsive state yang konsisten.
items.en_draft: The UI SSO Configuration, Sync Log, Audit Log, Active Sessions, User Accounts, Web Apps and the user dashboard are reorganized with hierarchy, compact table/card and a consistent responsive state.

items.bm: Maklumat peranti sesi diperbetulkan: kurungan brand kosong dibuang dan login baharu merekod jenis peranti, browser serta sistem operasi daripada User-Agent.
items.en_draft: Corrected session device information: empty brand brackets removed and new login records device type, browser and operating system from User-Agent.

items.bm: Single-user Resync User Info diperkukuh dengan external SELECT-only lookup, provenance protection, preview perubahan, one-time approval, confirmation, transaction, rollback dan correlated audit trail.
items.en_draft: Single-user Resync User Info is strengthened with external SELECT-only lookup, provenance protection, change preview, one-time approval, confirmation, transaction, rollback and correlated audit trail.

items.bm: Action modal Force Reset Password, Remove User dan Reactivate User diperkukuh dengan row lock, verified mutation, session/OTP revocation, mandatory correlated audit, transaction rollback dan perlindungan self-lockout.
items.en_draft: Modal actions Force Reset Password, Remove User and Reactivate User are strengthened with row lock, verified mutation, session/OTP revocation, mandatory correlated audit, transaction rollback and self-lockout protection.

items.bm: Memperkenalkan External Sync Preview yang read-only — memaparkan jumlah sumber, cadangan akaun baharu/kemas kini, deactivate/reactivate, perlindungan akaun manual, collision, plan hash dan tempoh sah tanpa mengubah database.
items.en_draft: Introducing a read-only External Sync Preview — displays total resources, new/update account recommendations, deactivate/reactivate, manual account protection, collision, hash plan and validity period without changing the database.

items.bm: Menambah lapisan keselamatan sync merangkumi single-run lock, transaction boundary, source completeness, blast-radius policy dan reconciliation sebelum commit.
items.en_draft: Adding a sync security layer includes single-run lock, transaction boundary, source completeness, blast-radius policy and reconciliation before commit.

items.bm: Preview dan Apply kini direka dengan server-bound approval, strict feature flags dan perlindungan replay; Apply kekal disabled sehingga semua gate operasi mendapat kelulusan.
items.en_draft: Preview and Apply are now designed with server-bound approval, strict feature flags and replay protection; Apply remains disabled until all operational gates are approved.

items.bm: Akaun yang ditambah secara manual mempunyai provenance dan perlindungan supaya external sync tidak menimpa akaun manual secara tidak sengaja.
items.en_draft: Manually added accounts have provenance and protection so that external sync does not accidentally overwrite manual accounts.

items.bm: Verification sync diperkukuh dengan regression contracts, external SELECT-only evidence, backup penuh dan isolated restore rehearsal.
items.en_draft: Sync verification is strengthened with regression contracts, external SELECT-only evidence, full backup and isolated restore rehearsal.

items.bm: Flow admin preview diperbetulkan supaya menggunakan token CSRF baharu selepas login dan session rotation.
items.en_draft: Fixed preview admin flow to use new CSRF token after login and session rotation.

items.bm: Paparan Version Releases direka semula menggunakan release cards yang lebih kemas, mudah dibaca dan responsive.
items.en_draft: The Version Releases display was redesigned using release cards that are neater, easier to read and responsive.

items.bm: Major security hardening untuk authentication dan authorization: server-side admin guard, default-deny action mapping, CSRF protection dan session regeneration.
items.en_draft: Major security hardening for authentication and authorization: server-side admin guard, default-deny action mapping, CSRF protection and session regeneration.

items.bm: Password legacy dimigrasikan secara terkawal kepada hash moden; reset password, OTP, rate limiting, session cookie dan token SSO diperkukuh.
items.en_draft: Legacy passwords are migrated in a controlled manner to modern hashes; password reset, OTP, rate limiting, session cookie and SSO token are strengthened.

items.bm: Secrets database, SMTP dan integrasi dipindahkan daripada source code kepada runtime secret configuration dengan permission yang lebih ketat.
items.en_draft: Database, SMTP and integration secrets are moved from source code to runtime secret configuration with stricter permissions.

items.bm: Upload icon diperketat menggunakan validation MIME/kandungan, allowlist format, nama rawak dan larangan script execution dalam direktori upload.
items.en_draft: Upload icon is tightened using MIME/content validation, format allowlist, random name and prohibition of script execution in the upload directory.

items.bm: Endpoint API, IDMS dan SKP diperkukuh melalui validation, parameterized query, TLS verification, response yang lebih selamat dan kawalan akses integrasi.
items.en_draft: Endpoint API, IDMS and SKP are strengthened through validation, parameterized query, TLS verification, more secure response and integration access control.

items.bm: Document root dimigrasikan sepenuhnya ke public/; source aplikasi, konfigurasi, docs, storage, tools dan database dump tidak lagi terdedah melalui web.
items.en_draft: Document root is fully migrated to public/; Application source, configuration, docs, storage, tools and database dump are no longer exposed through the web.

items.bm: Struktur projek disusun semula kepada boundary app/, bootstrap/, config/, public/, resources/, storage/, tests/ dan tools/ dengan compatibility wrapper untuk URL legacy yang masih sah.
items.en_draft: The project structure is rearranged to the boundaries of app/, bootstrap/, config/, public/, resources/, storage/, tests/ and tools/ with compatibility wrappers for legacy URLs that are still valid.

items.bm: Fail lama, diagnostic endpoint, duplicate implementation dan aset transitional melalui inventori, quarantine dan cleanup terkawal tanpa memutuskan login, API atau SSO consumer.
items.en_draft: Old files, diagnostic endpoints, duplicate implementations and transitional assets through controlled inventory, quarantine and cleanup without disconnecting login, API or SSO consumer.

items.bm: Kod application layer mula diekstrak kepada service, adapter, planner dan orchestrator yang boleh diuji tanpa mengubah caller production secara terus.
items.en_draft: The application layer code is first extracted to services, adapters, planners and orchestrators that can be tested without changing caller production directly.

items.bm: Manual Add User diperkukuh dengan validation, transaction, audit, provenance dan perlindungan collision dengan external source.
items.en_draft: The Add User manual is reinforced with validation, transaction, audit, provenance and collision protection with external sources.

items.bm: Automated characterization, contract tests, smoke tests, rollback runbook dan dokumentasi berfasa ditambah untuk menyokong deployment serta audit yang boleh diulang.
items.en_draft: Automated characterization, contract tests, smoke tests, rollback runbooks and phased documentation are added to support deployment and repeatable audits.

items.bm: Release penyelenggaraan terakhir untuk siri 1.x.x dan baseline sebelum program security hardening serta restructuring bermula.
items.en_draft: The last maintenance release for the 1.x.x and baseline series before the security hardening and restructuring program begins.

items.bm: Tiada patch baharu akan dikeluarkan untuk siri 1.x.x; versi ini dikekalkan sebagai rujukan legacy sahaja.
items.en_draft: No new patches will be released for the 1.x.x series; This version is maintained as a legacy reference only.

items.bm: Semua pembangunan seterusnya diteruskan melalui major upgrade v2.0.0.
items.en_draft: All further development continues through the major upgrade v2.0.0.

items.bm: Carian pengguna di panel admin kini lebih pantas — hasil carian nama, No. Staf/Pelajar, atau No. K/P dipaparkan dengan lebih cepat semasa taip.
items.en_draft: User search in the admin panel is now faster — name search result, No. Staff/Student, or No. K/P is displayed faster while typing.

items.bm: Menu baharu Sync Log — semak sejarah sync, statistik setiap sesi (baharu, dikemaskini, dinyahaktifkan, diaktifkan semula), dan butiran perubahan mengikut sesi.
items.en_draft: New Sync Log menu — check sync history, statistics per session (new, updated, deactivated, reactivated), and change details by session.

items.bm: Penjadual sync automatik berjalan setiap hari pada 12:00 tengah malam (00:00).
items.en_draft: The automatic sync scheduler runs every day at 12:00 midnight (00:00).

items.bm: Pembaikan bug kritikal pada penjadual sync — rekod sesi lebih tepat, elak sync berulang akaun yang sama, dan kestabilan proses harian.
items.en_draft: Critical bug fixes on the sync scheduler — more accurate session records, avoid repeated syncs of the same account, and daily process stability.

items.bm: Penambahbaikan Sync Pengguna: sistem hanya kemaskini akaun yang benar-benar berubah; sync lebih pantas dan tepat.
items.en_draft: User Sync improvements: the system only updates accounts that have actually changed; sync is faster and more accurate.

items.bm: Akaun staf/pelajar yang muncul semula dalam sumber data akan diaktifkan semula secara automatik.
items.en_draft: Staff/student accounts that reappear in the data source will be reactivated automatically.

items.bm: Data sync sebelum ini telah dikosongkan (truncate). 17 Jun 2026 menjadi tarikh mula sesi sync Generasi 2. Sync Generasi 1 mengandungi banyak bug dan tidak lagi dirujuk.
items.en_draft: The previous sync data has been emptied (truncate). June 17, 2026 is the start date of the Generation 2 sync session. Sync Generation 1 contains many bugs and is no longer referenced.

items.bm: Bahasa & istilah diseragamkan: Application → Sistem Aplikasi, Directory → Direktori Staf, FAQ → Soalan Lazim (FAQ), Logout → Log Keluar, Close → Tutup, Change → Tukar.
items.en_draft: Standardized language & terminology: Application → Application System, Directory → Staff Directory, FAQ → Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ), Logout → Log Out, Close → Close, Change → Change.

items.bm: ‘List of accessible apps’ → Senarai Sistem Aplikasi.
items.en_draft: 'List of accessible apps' → List of Application Systems.

items.bm: Kata Laluan Semasa (No. KP/No. Pasport), Kata Laluan Baharu, dan Sahkan Kata Laluan Baharu.
items.en_draft: Current Password (KP No./Passport No.), New Password, and Confirm New Password.

items.bm: Keperluan kata laluan: ≥8 aksara, ≥1 huruf kecil (a–z), ≥1 huruf besar (A–Z), ≥1 nombor (0–9), ≥1 aksara khas (cth: ! @ # $ %).
items.en_draft: Password requirements: ≥8 characters, ≥1 lowercase letter (a–z), ≥1 uppercase letter (A–Z), ≥1 number (0–9), ≥1 special character (eg: ! @ # $ %).

items.bm: Counter multiple login yang tersangkut: dimatikan & mesej: “Akaun dikunci. Sila log semula selepas 2 minit.”
items.en_draft: Stuck multiple login counter: turned off & message: "Account locked. Please log in again after 2 minutes."

items.bm: Rekod multiple attempt login dihantar ke modul Audit.
items.en_draft: Multiple login attempt records are sent to the Audit module.

items.bm: Had input login: Max 10 karakter, hanya A–Z, 0–9 dan “-”.
items.en_draft: Login input limit: Max 10 characters, only A–Z, 0–9 and “-”.

items.bm: Kategori tab “Non-SSO” ditukar nama kepada Pautan Terus.
items.en_draft: The “Non-SSO” tab category was renamed to Direct Links.

items.bm: Kategori Pautan Terus dialihkan ke akhir senarai tab.
items.en_draft: The Direct Links category is moved to the end of the tab list.

items.bm: Buang butang Logout pada menu Tukar Password (Dashboard).
items.en_draft: Remove the Logout button on the Change Password menu (Dashboard).

items.bm: Alert bertukar kepada SweetAlert (pusat skrin).
items.en_draft: Alert changes to SweetAlert (center of screen).

items.bm: Templat placeholder Login: No.Staf (XXXX-XX) / No.Pelajar. Password kali pertama: No. K/P.
items.en_draft: Login placeholder template: Staff No. (XXXX-XX) / Student No.. First time password: No. K/P.
